The '''Battle of Iktotch''' was a minor battle fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|You can't smash your way through the droid army...''"<br />"''Watch me.|Mace Windu and Saesee Tiin|<ref name="Heavy Metal Jedi" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]&mdash;himself an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]]&mdash;arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to free it from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. They saw that they had different uses of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], talking about precision and power.

At the beginning of the battle, the two Jedi Masters [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force Pushed]] [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], Windu destroying a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. Along with clone troopers, the Jedi advanced. They then crushed a Super Battle Droid into a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire'' droid]].

[[File:Ultra_battle_droid.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] face a [[B3 ultra battle droid]].]]

Just when the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began searching the Command Center, a prototype [[B3 ultra battle droid|ultra battle droid]] that the Separatists had created appeared. The droid opened fire and killed a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], and the two Jedi thought of a strategy to defeat it.

They then destroyed the droid one piece at a time: first, they destroyed its [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], then hit its knees. At this point, the droid launched some [[Homing missile/Legends|homing missiles]], but the Jedi used the Force to change the course of the missiles, making them detonate on the droid, which surprisingly survived. However, the Jedi quickly finished it, using a combination of speed and strength, managing to free [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]] and understanding that both precision and power are needed.
